questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right lane ends ahead — merge left
New lane added on the right
Right lane for right turns only

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead — merge left
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead and drivers in that lane must merge left into the adjacent lane. Check mirrors and merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Divided highway ahead — road will split with a median

questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ahead — road will split with a median
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes a divided highway with a median separating opposing traffic. Keep to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fire station ahead — watch for emergency vehicles

questions.correctAnswerText: Fire station ahead — watch for emergency vehicles
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a fire station ahead. Be alert for fire trucks and other emergency vehicles that may be entering the roadway suddenly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: One-way traffic circle — go left only

questions.correctAnswerText: Circular intersection (roundabout) ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a circular intersection or roundabout is ahead. Slow down, yield to traffic already in the roundabout, and enter when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Hairpin curve ahead — extremely sharp turn
Road ends at a dead end ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Hairpin curve ahead — extremely sharp turn
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a hairpin (180-degree) curve ahead. Reduce speed significantly before entering the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Speed limit changes on the ramp
Minimum speed on the exit ramp
Advisory speed for the exit ramp ahead
Speed limit for trucks on the ramp

questions.correctAnswerText: Advisory speed for the exit ramp ahead
questions.explanation: This sign shows the recommended safe speed for navigating the upcoming exit ramp. While not a legal limit, exceeding this speed may be dangerous on the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Ranch entrance ahead on the right
Cattle crossing ahead — watch for cattle on the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Cattle crossing ahead — watch for cattle on the road
questions.explanation: This sign warns that cattle may be crossing the road in this area. Slow down and be prepared to stop for animals on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Deer crossing — watch for deer on or near the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Deer crossing — watch for deer on or near the road
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an area where deer frequently cross the road. Be especially alert at dawn and dusk when deer are most active.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road bends slightly to the right
Sharp right curve ahead — reduce speed

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right curve ahead — reduce speed
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a sharp curve to the right. Reduce your speed well before the curve. Driving too fast through a sharp curve can cause you to lose control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp curve to the right ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp curve to the right ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a sharp curve to the right ahead. Slow down significantly before entering the curve to maintain control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic from the right ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Merging traffic from the right ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will be merging into your lane from the right. Adjust your speed and position to allow merging vehicles to enter safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Snowmobile crossing ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns that snowmobiles frequently cross the road in this area. Watch for snowmobiles, especially during winter months.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Advisory speed — recommended safe speed for the road condition ahead
Speed limit for this road segment
Speed zone ends at next intersection

questions.correctAnswerText: Advisory speed — recommended safe speed for the road condition ahead
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum recommended safe speed for a section of road ahead, such as a curve. It is a recommendation, not a legal speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: T-intersection ahead — prepare to turn
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a T-intersection where your road meets another road. Reduce speed and be prepared to yield or stop before turning left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Truck rollover warning — sharp curve ahead, reduce speed
Trucks must exit at this ramp
Steep downgrade — trucks use low gear

questions.correctAnswerText: Truck rollover warning — sharp curve ahead, reduce speed
questions.explanation: This sign warns truck drivers that the sharp curve ahead is dangerous and may cause rollover if speed is too high. All vehicles should reduce speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entering roadway with an added lane — you have your own lane
Acceleration lane — speed up to merge

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering roadway with an added lane — you have your own lane
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers entering a roadway that a new lane has been added for them. There is no need to merge immediately — you have your own lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Very sharp curve ahead — significantly reduce speed
Mountain pass curve with scenic view

questions.correctAnswerText: Very sharp curve ahead — significantly reduce speed
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an extremely sharp curve ahead. You must reduce your speed significantly to safely navigate the turn. Losing control on such curves is a common cause of serious accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery road ahead when wet
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road surface may become very slippery when wet. Reduce speed in wet conditions and avoid sudden braking, acceleration, or sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Steep hill ahead — be cautious of the grade

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep hill ahead — be cautious of the grade
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Trucks and heavy vehicles should gear down. Watch for slow-moving vehicles and be prepared to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Signal is broken — treat as stop sign
Traffic signal ahead — be prepared to stop

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic signal ahead — be prepared to stop
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a traffic signal ahead that may not be visible until you are close to it. Begin slowing down and be prepared to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic laws enforced by camera in this area

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic laws enforced by camera in this area
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic violations such as speeding or running red lights are monitored and recorded by cameras. Obey all traffic laws in this zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No passing zone — do not pass other vehicles

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zone — do not pass other vehicles
questions.explanation: This pennant-shaped sign marks the beginning of a no passing zone. Do not attempt to pass slower vehicles in this area as visibility or road conditions make it unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are about to enter a stretch of road where traffic moves in both directions. Stay on your side of the road and watch for oncoming vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp curve then straight road ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection within a curve ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection located within a curve. This is especially hazardous as visibility is limited. Reduce speed and be alert for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: T-intersection ahead — road ends, you must turn left or right

questions.correctAnswerText: T-intersection ahead — road ends, you must turn left or right
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road you are on ends ahead at a T-intersection. You must turn either left or right — you cannot go straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Advisory turn speed — recommended speed for the curve ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Advisory turn speed — recommended speed for the curve ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a curve ahead and recommends a safe speed for navigating it. The arrow shows the direction of the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left reverse turn ahead — sharp left then sharp right curve
Winding road ahead for several miles

questions.correctAnswerText: Left reverse turn ahead — sharp left then sharp right curve
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse turn ahead — a sharp left turn immediately followed by a sharp right turn (S-shaped road). Reduce speed before entering the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop sign ahead — be prepared to stop

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign ahead — be prepared to stop
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a stop sign is ahead. Begin slowing down so you can stop completely at the stop sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp curve ahead to the right
Side road enters at an angle ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Side road enters at an angle ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road enters the main road at an angle ahead. Watch for traffic entering from the side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merge from left lane into traffic
Highway on-ramp from the left ahead
Traffic entering from the left has its own lane — no merge needed

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic entering from the left has its own lane — no merge needed
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that a new lane is being added for traffic entering from the left. Through traffic does not need to merge or change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Road narrows ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes narrower ahead. Reduce speed and be prepared for less room on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic light ahead — prepare to stop
Emergency signal ahead — be prepared to stop
Emergency vehicle station on the right

questions.correctAnswerText: Emergency signal ahead — be prepared to stop
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an emergency traffic signal ahead, often near a fire station. Be prepared to stop when the signal is activated for emergency vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Y-intersection ahead — road splits into two directions

questions.correctAnswerText: Y-intersection ahead — road splits into two directions
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead splits into a Y-shape. Choose the correct direction and reduce speed as you approach the fork.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Truck crossing ahead — watch for trucks entering the road
No trucks allowed on this road

questions.correctAnswerText: Truck crossing ahead — watch for trucks entering the road
questions.explanation: This sign warns that trucks frequently cross or enter the road in this area. Be alert for slow-moving trucks and allow them extra space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Winding road ahead starting with a left curve

questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road ahead starting with a left curve
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road ahead that begins with a curve to the left. Reduce speed and be prepared for multiple curves in alternating directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left curve ahead — road curves to the left

questions.correctAnswerText: Left curve ahead — road curves to the left
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the left ahead. Reduce speed before the curve and stay in your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Farm machinery crossing — watch for slow farm vehicles
No farm vehicles allowed on this road

questions.correctAnswerText: Farm machinery crossing — watch for slow farm vehicles
questions.explanation: This sign warns that farm machinery may be crossing or entering the road in this area. These vehicles move very slowly — be prepared to slow down significantly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right curve ahead — road curves to the right

questions.correctAnswerText: Right curve ahead — road curves to the right
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a right curve ahead. Reduce your speed before entering the curve and keep your vehicle in the proper lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Crossroad ahead — another road crosses your road

questions.correctAnswerText: Crossroad ahead — another road crosses your road
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad or four-way intersection is ahead. Be alert for traffic entering from the left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entering roadway — merge right into traffic
New lane added — no merge needed
Weave area — traffic merging from both sides

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering roadway — merge right into traffic
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that drivers entering the roadway must merge to the right into the existing traffic flow. Yield to vehicles already on the highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield sign ahead — be prepared to yield

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield sign ahead — be prepared to yield
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a yield sign ahead. Slow down and be prepared to yield the right of way to other vehicles and pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Side road enters from the right at an angle
Right curve followed by side road

questions.correctAnswerText: Side road enters from the right at an angle
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road enters from the right at an angle. Watch for vehicles entering the main road from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Side road entering from the left ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Side road entering from the left ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road enters from the left ahead. Watch for vehicles that may be entering the main road from the left.
